book.title: ROM Rom mbal tuku waŋe Paulusŋge kuyarna

content: Sine Kuate tuku ndo minbe
Tira kame, tane Kuate tuku mape maŋau idusmba taŋgine ŋgarosu Kuate tuku ŋga madimba patikap le minwaig. Kuate nu atrau agaŋ taŋaŋ ta nu nzalite. Sine taŋaweg ta sine kumumbi Kuate mbariŋeg.

Tane kilke te tuku maŋau te-pur ndawap. Taŋgine wamdus Kuate mbolŋge palpe sulumba kitek mayok kape. Tane taŋamba Kuate tuku nzali kila palpe sulumba wam magenu o mbolŋge Kuate garete ta ke likam kumuŋ.
Piro saŋgri yimyam tuku pasa
Kuate nu ye make pilmba aposel pilna. Ye nyu tambi satiŋgamŋgit. Tane taŋgine miroŋ payam ndaka kumumbi pileŋgap. Kuate nu saŋgri yimyam tiŋgit ta idusmba taŋgine miroŋ pileŋgap.
Ŋgarosu ndindo mbolŋge agaŋ inum inumnu piro kise kise ke likade.
Taŋamba ndo sine Kristus ndoŋ ulendikeg mbal sine gudommba ta ŋgarosu ndindo ndo mineg. Ŋgarosu ta mbolŋge sine inum inumnu mineg ta ulendika ŋgarosu ndindo.

Kuate nu sine ŋakmba make patika sine yimyam saŋgri kise kise ake siŋgit tambi sine pirokube. Ande nu Tukul Guwa tugumŋge pasa ismba kile-mayokkam tuku saŋgri tate ta nu nuŋe ŋgamuŋgal son maŋau tambi kile-mayokkuwa.
Ande nu taŋgo turkam tuku saŋgri tate ta nu taŋgo turkuwa. Ande nu pasa kukliwam tuku saŋgri tate ta nu pasa kukliwa.

Ande nu taŋgo saŋgri pileniŋgam tuku saŋgri tate ta nu saŋgri pileniŋguwa. Ande nu agaŋ ndende ŋak afu turka niŋgam tuku saŋgri tate ta nu waknyumba niŋguwa. Ande nu gabat taŋgo minam tuku saŋgri tate ta nu wamdus saŋgrinu pilmba piro ta kuwa. Ande nu sinamanzerka minig mbal turkam tuku saŋgri tate ta nu gare ŋak turkuwa.
Tira kame ŋgamuŋgal niŋgam tuku pasa
Tane wamdus tugusekmbi muŋgu kume purkap. Tane maŋau ŋaigonu ŋakmba ŋgumneniŋmba maŋau magenu ndo bige dedeŋgap.
Taŋgine tira kat taŋgine taŋaŋ taŋgine taŋgine muŋgu kume purkap. Tane taŋgine taŋgine tira kame tuku nyu kile-duŋgam tuku ŋgamuŋgal kunde-kundetiŋguwa.
Tane kanyum ndamba saŋgri tiŋga pirokap. Tukul Guwa mbolŋge tumail gare ŋak mayok kape sulumba Suŋgo tuku piro mbal minap.
Tane muskil kile-tidiŋge tiŋgam tuku tairŋgade ta tuku gare-gareka minmba piti sinamŋge ŋgan pilmba dirnaŋgap. Tane mara mara Kuate yabaŋmba minmba
Kuate tuku mbal agaŋ ndende denkade ta turkap sulumba kisekok mbal kilmba taŋgine wande mbolŋge patikap.
Tane piti sertiŋgig mbal Kuateŋge nane sinzaŋniŋguwa ŋga yabaŋap sulumba nane nyaro pasa niŋmba kasur pasa niŋge ndakap.
Nane gare ŋak minig mbal ndoŋ tane gare-garekap. Nane piti ŋak minmba malmbikade mbal ndoŋ tane malmbikap.
Tane tira kame ndoŋ wamdus ulendika tuma minmba sine sugo ŋga piro nyu kugatok ta kam tuku mbule ndakap. Tane sine kila sugo ŋak ŋga idus ndawap.
Ande tane mbolŋge maŋau ŋayonu kuwa kande tane maŋau ŋayonumbi lafu ndawap. Taŋgo ŋakmba ŋgamukŋge maŋau tiŋreknu ndo ke likap.
Tane taŋgo ŋakmba ndoŋ ŋgamuŋgal ulendi minam tuku ndin sotap.
Tira kame, nane afu tane mbolŋge maŋau ŋaigonu kuwaig le tane Kuateŋge lafuwa ŋga piti ta nu wai mbolŋge ndo palpe. Kuate tuku kuyar ta tuku teŋenmba sakate.

content.text: Suŋgo nu sakate: Maŋau ŋaigonu lafunu ta ye tuku piro. Yeŋge pa ta niŋgamŋgit ŋgate. Lo 32.35

content: Kuyar pasa ande teŋenmba sakate.

content.text: Ne tuku ŋgueu taŋgo nu gubawa kande nyamagaŋ tawe le nyuwa. Nu kule parawa kande kule tawe le nyuwa.
Ne taŋawa ta nu nuŋe ŋgueu maŋau ta tuku kiko tumba wamdus rar prowa le kamusmba minamŋgat ŋgate. Sindaun 25.21

content: Maŋau ŋaigonu taŋge tane kile-ibeŋkikat ŋga tane nu mape ndawap. Taŋgine maŋau magenu tambi maŋau ŋaigonu ta kile-ibeŋkap.
